Danny's Cycles Scarsdale Sunday Road Ride

Scarsdale, NY · Road

No-drop

Danny's Cycles Scarsdale Sunday Road Ride is a road group ride in Scarsdale, NY. It rolls every Sunday at 9:30 am from Danny's Cycles Scarsdale. About 30–35 miles, 12–15 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Danny's Cycles Scarsdale Sunday Road Ride group ride

A no-drop Sunday morning shop ride out of Scarsdale, open to anyone, not just customers. Fair-weather only. The shop also runs Saturday gravel/road rides and an MTB ride from Mohegan Lake.
